subject: Approval Request: Zoom Pro Payment Method
body:
Hi Arif,

Our card for the PoliPrep Zoom Pro plan was declined. Service will pause on Wednesday 25 November at 23:59 unless the payment method is updated, which will stop all live meetings. Could you please approve updating the payment card before the deadline?

Best,
Hamid, PoliPrep
reason: Payment task task-001 needs Arif's approval

subject: Re: Refund request, CEnT-S course
body: Hello, thank you for reaching out. Under our withdrawal policy, we offer a 14-day right of withdrawal with a full refund only if the student has not started the course. Because your son has already watched the first classes, we unfortunately cannot issue a full refund. Best regards, Hamid, PoliPrep

subject: CEnT-S Cohort 1 & Black Friday pricing
body: Hi, thanks for reaching out! Cohort 1 has at most 20 students. Our Black Friday price is €399 for CEnT-S from 23 to 30 November 2026 (23:59 Rome) with no code needed, so it will be valid for you during that period. Best regards, Ulu, PoliPrep
